newsitem.title: UK: Pacificorp finds telecom buyer to aid UK bid -paper.
newsitem.headline: Pacificorp finds telecom buyer to aid UK bid -paper.

text.p: U.S. utility PacifiCorp has found a buyer who will pay 1.0 billion pounds for its telecoms business -- a deal it needs to help fund its planned acquisition of Britain's Energy Group Plc, The Times reported.

The newspaper reported in its Friday edition that Pacificorp, which has over 3.0 billion pounds of debt, would sell 11 local telecoms franchises in the American West but had declined to identify the buyer.

An agreed takeover of Energy Group, whose businesses span Britain's biggest electricity supplier Eastern and the world's biggest coalminer Peabody, is expected on Friday or Monday, sources close to the talks have told Reuters in New York.

The Daily Telegraph said that an $8-10 billion financing package was being assembled for the deal between the two heavily indebted companies amid strong denials that the new company would start life with a considerable element of "junk bonds".

Pacificorp and Energy have agreed a 696p per share cash bid -- 20 percent above Energy's recent 580p share price -- valuing the bid at 3.6 billion pounds, one source close to the talks has told Reuters.
